evidence: With torchvision blocked, AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct") raises ValueError: Unrecognized image processor in HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct..., matching the bug report.
steps: Create an isolated venv with the local transformers source on PYTHONPATH.
Install torch and the non-vision runtime dependencies, but do not install torchvision.
Run repro.py, which blocks torchvision imports and calls AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct").
